name: read_skill_resource
description: Read one bundled resource from an installed skill package. `path` is relative to the resource directory reported by `list_skill_resources` or `load_skill`.

path.description: Relative path inside the skill's bundled resource directory, e.g. 'references/guide.md' or 'examples/demo.md'.

limit.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes to return (default and maximum: 65536). Longer content is truncated with a paging hint.
